title: verify
caption: verify is the only command that can print VERIFIED. Here checks 4 to 7 pass and 1 to 3 are INCOMPLETE because no timestamp authority proved the times: exit 6.
alt: Terminal output of pr-rla verify: checks listed, ending INCOMPLETE exit 6

commands.output:
1. INCOMPLETE registration: registration after window close → RETROSPECTIVE (a demonstration) (unproven: too few timestamps)
2. INCOMPLETE manifest before seed: manifest written (signed time, unproven) 2026-10-20T12:00:00Z: not shown to precede R
3. INCOMPLETE seed round: R = 33,245,812: first round ≥ 24 h after registration, but the registration time it rests on is unproven
4. PASS BLS: BLS
5. PASS population: population 1,589/1,589 match
6. PASS draws: 36/36 draws reproduce
7. WARN labels: labels (prefix 36, 34 events)
INCOMPLETE: check 1 (registration), check 2 (manifest before seed), check 3 (seed round) could not be established; nothing failed, but this is not a verification (exit 6)
